usage: The word 渡輪 (dou6 leon4) is a noun and refers to a type of boat used to carry passengers and vehicles across water.
It is commonly used when talking about traveling between islands or across a harbor.
In sentences, 渡輪 usually appears as the subject or object, such as '我坐渡輪去離島' (I take the ferry to the outlying island).
When describing a mode of transport, 渡輪 can be combined with verbs like '坐' (to sit/take) or '搭' (to ride).
渡輪 can also appear in questions asking about travel methods, like '你有冇坐過渡輪？' (Have you ever taken a ferry?).
